About this learning activity

In this recorded webinar, Ray Evans from IBM's X-Force Red team gives an overview of vulnerability management in the cybersecurity field, both generally and with respect to penetration testing. It includes a live demo of the Qualys vulnerability scanning tool, and an overview of solutioning and design for effective VMS. There is also Q&A.

The live event was produced in partnership with SkillsBuild partner SaluteMyJob.

After you complete this activity, return to this page to select Mark complete for completion credit.

Note: This activity is available only in English.

title: PURPL UNICORN - Introduction to Penetration Testing
description: Delve into the world of penetration testing and examine the common types of penetration testing and the important role they play in protecting your company's assets and networks from exploits and attacks.
